_doc: 30.10 server registry for bench/wst (paths relative to the repo root via {root}; see bench/wispsuite/servers.py). 'extra' = wbench run args for that server.

files.epoxy-{port}.toml:
[server]
bind = ["tcp", "127.0.0.1:{port}"]
runtime = "multithread"

[stream]
allow_loopback = true
allow_non_global = true

epoxy.note: epoxy-server multithread, loopback + non-global targets allowed (matrix.main.json); upstream 9cde724 (2026-10-22, latest multiplexed) built as its README says (cargo b -r: its Cargo.lock, tokio-websockets 0.12.0, which panics under load and takes the server down); ref/epoxy-tls-9cde724 (a git worktree of ref/epoxy-tls)

holywisp.cmd: {root}/ref/holywisp-1758e6a/build/release/holywisp --host 127.0.0.1 --port {port} --allow-loopback on --allow-private on --allow-direct-ip on --flood-protection off --connections-limit-per-ip 0 --connection-window-s 0 --reputation off --log-level error
holywisp.note: UNOFFICIAL: holyWisp (github.com/Fracital/holyWisp, C) upstream 1758e6a (2026-11-13), built with `make release` in ref/holywisp-1758e6a (a git worktree of ref/holywisp); its flood limits, per-IP connection rate and reputation are on by default and would throttle a loopback benchmark (all streams to one target from one IP), so they are off here, like the other servers' (they have none on)
